clue.text: Reading article in the wrong way

indicators.note: letters arranged in the wrong way are out of order, so the word article is to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A grammar point: someone reading a sentence with the article placed wrongly.
explanation.definitionFit: A public performance of poems or prose read aloud is a recital, so a reading is one kind of it.

clue.text: What bailiff may do rests on entering rear of properties repeatedly

indicators.note: repeatedly means the chosen last letter is used again, a second time at the end
entering means the following letter goes inside the word for rests on

parts.note: to repose on something is to rest on it, so rests on gives the verb form reposes

indicators.note: the rear of a word is its final letter, here the last letter of properties

explanation.surface: A bailiff's routine of going round the back of one house after another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rear of properties' is S; 'entering' puts it inside REPOSES after REPOS, and 'repeatedly' uses that S again at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Bailiffs seize goods or property when debts go unpaid, which is the act of taking back possession.

clue.text: My face is friendly

parts.note: 'my!' and 'cor!' are both exclamations of surprise; cor is British slang
the face of a clock or watch is its dial

explanation.surface: Someone saying that their own expression is a welcoming one.
explanation.walkthrough: COR is a British exclamation like 'gosh!', so 'My' (as in 'My, how lovely!') gives it.
explanation.definitionFit: A cordial greeting or manner is warm and genial: a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Appeal to dictator's worked on a short-term basis

indicators.note: a dictator here is one who dictates, speaking words aloud for someone to write, so what follows is judged by sound

parts.note: to temp is to work as a temporary employee, so the past tense is temped

explanation.surface: Someone petitioning a tyrant who once held only a short-term post.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dictator' looks like a tyrant but means someone dictating aloud, so TEMPED is heard as the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To attract or entice someone is to appeal to them, which is what luring with temptation does.

clue.text: Girlie magazine's "ultimate pair" shot in underwear

indicators.note: shot means wrecked or ruined, signalling that the letters are broken up and rearranged
the ultimate pair of a word is its last two letters, taken from magazine

explanation.surface: A racy magazine's photo shoot of its final two models in their smalls.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ultimate pair' of magazine gives NE; with GIRLIE that is shuffled by 'shot'.
explanation.definitionFit: Women's undergarments, especially delicate ones, are lingerie: a specific kind of underwear.

clue.text: Niche publication's excellent coverage of Australia and New Zealand

indicators.note: coverage of means the word for excellent wraps round the abbreviations that follow

parts.note: fine is a synonym of excellent
A is the international vehicle code for Austria but used in crosswords for Australia as well

explanation.surface: A specialist magazine praised for its fine reporting from the Antipodes.
explanation.definitionFit: Amateur magazines for enthusiasts of a hobby, band or genre are small-circulation niche publications.

clue.text: Crooked former partner left before getting arrested by US agent

indicators.note: being arrested means held by the agent, so these letters sit inside the word for him

parts.note: a Fed is an American federal agent, such as an FBI officer

indicators.note: before places the abbreviation for left ahead of the word for an old partner

parts.note: an ex is a former spouse or partner

explanation.surface: A corrupt ex-partner who fled before being caught by an FBI man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crooked' reads as dishonest, but here it means bent.
explanation.definitionFit: Something flexed has been bent, and crooked describes something bent out of straight.

clue.text: Learn tune having developed artificial intelligence

indicators.note: developed means grown into a new form, so the letters of the two words change their order

explanation.surface: A computer that has taught itself to pick up melodies.
explanation.definitionFit: A network of connected computing nodes modelled on the brain is a common form of machine learning in AI.

clue.text: Say how female becomes male to resolve issues

definitions.meaning: Fe is the chemical symbol for iron, and taking it from the front of female leaves male
to smooth away problems or difficulties

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about gender change, followed by a call to settle disputes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is a link word. The first reading is a cryptic description: remove the element symbol FE from FEMALE.
explanation.definitionFit: To smooth out difficulties, like pressing creases flat, is an idiom for settling problems.

clue.text: Provide with support to eliminate resistance

indicators.note: eliminate means remove, so the abbreviation for resistance comes out of the word for support

parts.note: to endure is to bear or put up with, one sense of support
R is the symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: Giving backing to a campaign so as to overcome opposition.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic verb meaning to endow or furnish someone with a quality.

clue.text: Promise that case will introduce precedent?

indicators.note: something that introduces another comes first, so the word for case goes in front of the word for promise

parts.note: a portmanteau is a large travelling case that opens in two halves
giving your word is making a promise

explanation.surface: A lawyer's case that will set a precedent built on someone's promise.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface is legal, but 'case' is luggage. The question mark flags a playful definition: the joined-up term is itself the model for blends like brunch and smog.
explanation.definitionFit: Lewis Carroll's coinage for a blend of two words set the pattern for every later blend, so it is a precedent of sorts.

clue.text: Island popular with the British and French lying within South Africa and Namibia's borders

indicators.note: lying within means placed between the letters that surround them
the borders of a word are its outer letters

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
the is the English, that is British, definite article
le is the French for the

explanation.surface: A tourist island that Britons and French visitors love, between southern African countries.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' and 'and' are link words. The 'borders' of Namibia are N and A.
explanation.definitionFit: A remote British island in the South Atlantic, famous as Napoleon's place of exile.

clue.text: Number between 0 and 2.718 …

indicators.note: between places the abbreviation for number with a letter either side

parts.note: the figure zero looks like the letter O
e, the base of natural logarithms, is approximately 2.718

explanation.surface: A maths question asking for a whole number lying between zero and e.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both the wordplay and the definition: the integer in that range is the only one.
explanation.definitionFit: The only whole number greater than zero and less than e (about 2.718) is the first counting number.

clue.text: … lies at regular intervals on endless curve

indicators.note: endless means the final letter is cut from the word for curve

parts.note: an ellipse is an oval curve

indicators.note: taking letters at regular intervals means every second letter of lies

explanation.surface: Something lies at intervals along a looping curve.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' is a link word. The definition is the three dots that start the clue, carrying on from the clue before.
explanation.definitionFit: Three dots marking an omission or a trailing-off are a punctuation mark with this name.

clue.text: Beating of one's heart is up a lot following training

indicators.note: training means shaping or drilling into a new form, so the letters are rearranged
the heart of a word is its middle letter, here the centre of one

explanation.surface: After exercise, someone's heart is racing a great deal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of' and 'following' are link words. N is the heart of 'one'.
explanation.definitionFit: A rhythmic throb or beat, as of the heart or an artery, is a synonym of beating.

clue.text: 11-a-side?

parts.note: 11 is the answer at 11 across, so the clue reads as made into a single unit, and also a football team's name

explanation.surface: A sporting format with eleven players per team.
explanation.walkthrough: 11 refers to the answer at 11 across; football sides like Manchester United play eleven-a-side.
explanation.definitionFit: Things joined together have been made into a single whole, and many football clubs carry this name.

clue.text: Small vessel's incomplete attempt measured after capsizing

indicators.note: capsizing means overturning, so in a down clue the letters are read upwards
incomplete means the last letter of the word for attempt is missing

parts.note: an essay is an attempt or try
timed means measured with a clock

explanation.surface: A small boat's half-hearted trial run, timed after it overturned.
explanation.walkthrough: ''s' stands for 'is' and is a link word. ESSA plus TIMED, overturned, gives DEMITASSE.
explanation.definitionFit: A small coffee cup for espresso: a vessel in the sense of a container, not a boat.

clue.text: Reasonable description of 11 and 25, in particular, and in general

definitions.text: description of 11 and 25, in particular, and in general
definitions.meaning: the number at 11 across and the number 25 are both ratios of whole numbers, and so are the 25-across figures generally

explanation.walkthrough: '25' works two ways: the clue number 25 across (the whole counting numbers) and the number twenty-five itself.
explanation.definitionFit: A sensible person is logical, and in maths a number expressible as a fraction is called by the same word.

clue.text: 11 or 7-inch?

definitions.meaning: the answer at 11 across, the number meaning just one
a seven-inch vinyl record carrying one song on each side

explanation.walkthrough: 'or' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Only one is solitary, and the small vinyl record of a song released on its own carries the same name.

clue.text: I represented 11 in this capacity …

parts.note: the letter I stands for the number at 11 across in the Roman system, acting as a written symbol for a number

explanation.surface: Someone saying they once stood for their team in a particular role.
explanation.walkthrough: 11 is the number at 11 across, and I is its Roman form.
explanation.definitionFit: A symbol standing for a number, like the Roman I, is a figure of this kind.

clue.text: Non-fiction books let me think he's useful in many ways

parts.note: fact is the opposite of fiction
OT is the Old Testament, the first books of the Bible
um is the sound of hesitation while thinking

explanation.surface: Someone pausing over whether a man's non-fiction books are useful.
explanation.definitionFit: A servant or employee who does all kinds of jobs is a general handyman of many uses.

clue.text: … consequently admitting about 11 into it

indicators.note: admitting means letting in, so the word for consequently holds the next letters

parts.note: then means as a consequence
re means about or concerning
the number at 11 across is written I in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Carrying on from the last clue: as a result, letting the number in.
explanation.walkthrough: The opening dots continue from 18 down.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal adverb meaning in that place or in that thing, matching in or into it.

clue.text: Fair description of 11 and 25, in particular, but not in general

definitions.meaning: honest and even-handed, as in a fair deal

definitions.text: description of 11 and 25, in particular, but not in general
definitions.meaning: the number at 11 across and twenty-five are each a whole number times itself, but most counting numbers are not

explanation.walkthrough: Partners 16 down: 25 is both the number twenty-five (five times five) and 25 across, the counting numbers, which are not all of this kind.
explanation.definitionFit: A fair deal is an honest one, and a number that is the product of a whole number with itself shares the name.

clue.text: Cumulative effect of wrestling without entering ring

indicators.note: without the ring entering means the ring-shaped letter is left out of the word for wrestling

parts.note: sumo is the Japanese style of wrestling
O is ring-shaped

explanation.surface: The overall outcome of a wrestling bout fought without stepping into the ring.
explanation.definitionFit: The total produced by adding things together is their combined, cumulative result.

clue.text: Clothing has to be removed from cushions in church

indicators.note: removed from means the word has is taken out of the word for the church cushions

parts.note: hassocks are cushions for kneeling on in church

explanation.surface: Garments must be cleared off the kneeling cushions in a church.
explanation.definitionFit: Garments worn on the feet are items of clothing: a definition by category.

clue.text: Stress about question that is the first stage in someone consenting

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for stress goes round the following letters

parts.note: accent means emphasis or stress
i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, meaning that is

indicators.note: the first stage in a word is its opening letter, from someone

explanation.surface: Strain over a question that marks the start of someone giving consent.
explanation.definitionFit: Agreeing quietly without protest is the meaning of acquiescent, so it fits consenting.

clue.text: Educational facilities set up without power plant

indicators.note: without means the letter for power is left out
set up in a down clue means the letters are reversed, read upwards

parts.note: a campus is the grounds and buildings of a university or college
P is the symbol for power in physics

explanation.surface: Schools and colleges built without electricity.
explanation.definitionFit: A shrub or small tree with red berries, used as a spice, is a plant of this name.

clue.text: Cannibals murder unfortunate figures, the smallest being 11

indicators.note: unfortunate means badly off or unlucky, suggesting the letters fall into a disorderly new arrangement

explanation.surface: Cannibals kill some unlucky people, the smallest victim being just one.
explanation.walkthrough: 11 is the number at 11 across, the smallest counting number.
explanation.definitionFit: The counting numbers used for quantity are called by this name, starting from the number at 11 across.

clue.text: Muted reaction after being invaded by the French

indicators.note: being invaded means having something enter, so the French article goes inside the word for after

parts.note: since means after, as in 'since the war'
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A subdued response after the French invaded.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying nothing at all is the quietest possible response, so absence of sound is a muted reaction.

clue.text: Allow predecessor to get out of order

indicators.note: out of order means jumbled, so the letters of the previous answer are rearranged

parts.note: the predecessor is the answer to the clue just before, 26 across, which is SILENCE

explanation.surface: Letting the one who came before step out of line.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram fodder is not printed: it is the answer to the preceding clue.
explanation.definitionFit: To permit something officially is to grant a licence for it; the American spelling of the verb.
